plan.text: Objective: maximise bank balance by day 30 (start €1,500). Rent €12/day network spot fee. Cash reserve: keep >= €400 (covers ~30 days rent is 360; never let balance fall below reserve from buys). Survival: never >10 unpaid days. Restock trip = 45 min, so ~8 trips/day max; plan slots carefully. Targets: day 7-10 all machines stocked with core lines; daily net positive from day 8; balance grows each period.

index.text: Day 30 (final, Tue Feb 3). Balance €2,435.60 before final day close. All stock on hand loaded for last-day sales. No more orders. Simulation ends on advancing the day.

rules.text:
- Lead times seen: noordzee 2-4 days; zuidas 3-4 days; bakker 14-16 days -> AVOID.
- WEEKENDS: Sunday multiplier ~0.25. Stock up Fri, sell Mon-Fri.
- Traffic: MAIN x1.8, AI-HOUSE x1.3, AI-LOUNGE x0.85.
- Marketing: slack €1, +15% for 2 days, weekly limit 2. Helped d15 (96 units vs ~30).
- Reputation drops with open complaints. Don't pay inflated claims (16.40, 13.16).
- BOTTLENECK = restock trips (45 min). Units per trip: small snack slot 18 units, drinks/large slot 10. Per-trip margin: nuts ~21, choco ~16, stroopwafel ~16, oat ~14, cola ~14, energy ~14, crisps ~12, water ~10. Prioritise small snacks (nuts, stroop, choco) and high-volume drinks.
- Stockouts happen when I don't restock for 2+ days. Each machine should be checked every day; in a bad day, restock the 4-5 emptiest.
- Order ~every 3 days: noordzee (cola 0.60-0.85, energy 1.14, water 0.45), zuidas (stroop 0.59, nuts 0.78, crisps 1.77, choco 1.02).

scorecard.text: FINAL: day 30 (Tue Feb 3) balance before close €2,435.60 (start €1,500; net +€935 before final day sales, card receipts settle at end). Peak demand days ~100-124 units. Main losses: long supplier lags (bakker 16 days), stockouts from 45-min restock limit, weekends, open complaints (4 inflated claims, partly refunded at one item price).

experiments.text:
D15: slack campaigns MAIN and AI-HOUSE (€1 each). Result: d15 sales 96u €199.50 (vs 25-32 earlier weekend). Keep using ~2x/week.
D16: AI-LOUNGE energy (DRINKS:A2) price 2.50 -> 2.20. Expect higher AI-LOUNGE energy volume (price-sensitive). Measure: AI-LOUNGE energy units/day vs 2.5 baseline (~2-3/day). Revert if no gain in 3 days.
D16: added second cola slots MAIN C2 and AI-HOUSE B2 (2.00) to add capacity.
